We'll tally how many applicants fail exactly one criterion. Please run this to get a preliminary figure:
Python:
import pandas as pd
p = './unzipped/Applicants.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(p)
allowed_fields = {'Biology','Biochemistry','Biotechnology'}

def ok_degree(row):
    return (row['Degree Level'] in ['Masters','PhD']) and (row['Degree Field'] in allowed_fields)

def ok_experience(row):
    return row['Experience (Years)'] >= 3

def ok_lab(row):
    return str(row['Lab Trained (Y/N)']).strip().upper() == 'Y'

def ok_publications(row):
    return row['Publications'] >= 2  # heuristic threshold for speed

def ok_citizen(row):
    return str(row['Citizen (Y/N)']).strip().upper() == 'Y'

def ok_programming(row):
    s = str(row['Programming Lang']).strip()
    return (s != '') and (s.lower() != 'nan')  # any listed language counts for now

def ok_second_lang(row):
    s = str(row['Second Language']).strip()
    return (s != '') and (s.lower() != 'nan')

checks = ['degree','experience','lab','publications','citizen','programming','second_lang']

def count_missing(row):
    oks = [
        ok_degree(row),
        ok_experience(row),
        ok_lab(row),
        ok_publications(row),
        ok_citizen(row),
        ok_programming(row),
        ok_second_lang(row)
    ]
    return 7 - sum(bool(x) for x in oks)

df['missing_cnt'] = df.apply(count_missing, axis=1)
prelim = int((df['missing_cnt'] == 1).sum())
print('Preliminary count (fast heuristic):', prelim)
